title: Service: Data Integration
text: Service: Data Integration. Data Integration: secure and reliable ETL or ELT pipelines, API-based automation, real-time or batch synchronization across on-premise, cloud and hybrid systems, with attention to data quality, consistency and security. Business value: removes silos, unified real-time view, automated processes, accurate reporting. Tools: Talend, SSIS (Microsoft), MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, n8n.

title: Service: BI & Dashboarding
text: Service: BI & Dashboarding. BI & Dashboarding: data modeling, KPI definition, advanced visualization, and semantic layers on top of ERP, CRM, cloud services and databases, for finance, operations, marketing and HR teams. Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Google Data Studio / Looker Studio.

title: Service: AI Development
text: Service: AI Development. AI Development: end-to-end AI projects covering ideation, data preparation, model development, testing, deployment and monitoring. Technologies: machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and generative AI. Solutions are designed to be scalable, explainable and integrated into existing processes. Use cases: automating repetitive tasks, anomaly detection, customer personalization, logistics optimization, demand forecasting. AI tooling listed on the site: Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, n8n, BigQuery.

title: Service: Salesforce Ecosystem
text: Service: Salesforce Ecosystem. Salesforce Ecosystem: implementation, customization and API integration of Salesforce with the client's information system. Clouds: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, CRM and CRM Analytics. Automation via Flow, Apex and Lightning, plus platform governance. Goal: a 360-degree customer view, better lead tracking and automated service interactions. OliveSoft is listed as a Salesforce Integration Partner.

title: Service: Data Platform
text: Service: Data Platform. Data Platform: design and management of modern scalable data infrastructure including data lakes, data warehouses and data marts on cloud or on-premise, covering ingestion, storage, catalog management and data governance. Technologies: Snowflake, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Apache Kafka.

title: Technology and platform summary
text: Technology and platform summary. Technologies mastered by OliveSoft teams: Integration/automation: MuleSoft, Boomi, Talend, SSIS, Workato, Make, Power Automate, n8n. Cloud/data: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Kafka, Dataform. BI: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Looker Studio. CRM: Salesforce. AI: Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, CoAtNet, FAISS. ERP/HR systems seen in projects: Sage X3, Cegid, SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Connect.

text: Strategic partnerships.
